section.name: PierLevelSeatOverride
section.heading: Adopted override D-064: level pier pedestal tops
section.paragraph: Adopted by user direction on 20 October 2026. Record this exception in the journal and carry it into the design atlas. It changes the design direction for the pier pedestal tops; this documentary update does not modify the geometry files.

dynexp.formula: BP_pier_seat_override = "D-064: ADOPT LEVEL PIER PEDESTAL TOPS"
dynexp.expbody: BP_pier_seat_override = "D-064: ADOPT LEVEL PIER PEDESTAL TOPS"

section.paragraph: Design decision: detail each pier pedestal top as one horizontal plane, including both bearing areas and the intervening top surface.
Adopted transverse rise/run = 0, equivalent to 0%; maintain the zero transverse beam-tilt assumption of the bearing check.

dynexp.formula: BP_pier_seat_override_scope = "Pier only: two pedestals serving bearings B1/B2 and B3/B4"
dynexp.expbody: BP_pier_seat_override_scope = "Pier only: two pedestals serving bearings B1/B2 and B3/B4"

section.paragraph: Apply to the two pier pedestals and all four pier bearings. End-bent pedestal elevations and slopes are outside this override.

dynexp.formula: BP_pier_seat_override_basis = "T019 / D-063: BearingDesign.PierLevelSeatCheck; conditional on its live checks and stated assumptions"
dynexp.expbody: BP_pier_seat_override_basis = "T019 / D-063: BearingDesign.PierLevelSeatCheck; conditional on its live checks and stated assumptions"

section.paragraph: The preceding native rotation and longitudinal movement calculation remains the calculation authority. Standard Type F pads accommodate the checked beam rotations; this decision does not introduce a tapered pad or establish final combined bearing adequacy.

Constructability basis: replace the small calculated pier seat slopes with level tops under the level-seat allowance evaluated in the preceding check. The adopted zero slopes supersede the calculated sloped pier-top geometry for detailing. This is a recorded engineering exception, not a change to the bridge profile, beam camber or source analysis.

dynexp.formula: BP_pier_seat_geometry_status = "PENDING IMPLEMENTATION: bridge geometry notebook, B4 geometry tables, CAD and drawings"
dynexp.expbody: BP_pier_seat_geometry_status = "PENDING IMPLEMENTATION: bridge geometry notebook, B4 geometry tables, CAD and drawings"

section.paragraph: The existing Bridge_Geometry_2 Beam_V2.ipynb and B4_Geometry_CAD_Tables.xlsx still contain the calculated sloped seats. Retain them as source evidence until a coordinated update applies this override; the atlas must show the adoption separately from implementation status.

dynexp.formula: BP_pier_seat_elevation_status = "No new numeric top elevation selected; reconcile one common top elevation per pedestal and pad/beam interfaces in the geometry update"
dynexp.expbody: BP_pier_seat_elevation_status = "No new numeric top elevation selected; reconcile one common top elevation per pedestal and pad/beam interfaces in the geometry update"

section.paragraph: When implementing, reconcile the pedestal elevation schedule to a common top plane for each pedestal and verify pad thickness, beam seating, cap geometry, reinforcement cover and clearances. No existing sloped corner elevation is silently reclassified as an adopted level elevation.

Applicability and remaining checks: retain the selected saved beam-design results, standard pad construction and zero transverse beam tilt used in T019. Recheck after changes to grade, camber/end rotations, loads, pad geometry or support details. Combined wind/lateral shear, uplift/contact, external-analysis currency/load reconciliation and final support/plate detailing remain open. No end-bent approval or final bearing acceptance is recorded here.
